ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) across the central 60% of visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) regions concentrated on the distal lobes comprising approximately 40% of the pixel distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white fields are located on the distal third of both lobes. Left lobe exhibits a white field with dense black speckling. Right lobe features a larger white field containing distinct, roughly circular black pigment rosettes and irregular mottling transitioning into the central black region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations with variable amplitudes (2-10 pixels) across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged peaks are localized near the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves fitted to both trailing edges, exhibiting a distinct posterior-to-dorsal sweep toward the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of 5-7 circular dark-on-white pixel clusters (rosettes) localized in the mid-distal region of the right lobe fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: High-contrast, textured white pixel clusters indicative of barnacle colonization are visible on the extreme terminal edges of both the left and right lobes. Circular scar patterns are present on the right ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, irregular calcified encrustations (barnacles) localized specifically on the dorsal-ventral transition of the extreme lateral tips.
